correctness.rationale: Reconstructed xy=(x·y)u from nonzero equal natural-basis squares, Gram condition P^TP=I, graph support=weight(P^T u). In characteristic two, x·x=x·1 forces orthogonal matrices to fix 1; weight parity is preserved. Coordinate permutations and 4-coordinate transvections reduce noncanonical odd vectors to weight 1 and nonzero even vectors to weight 2 (n=3 boundaries checked), establishing exhaustive orbits. Independently enumerated ALL 6 orthonormal bases in n=3 and 48 in n=4 and support spectra for all 22 nonzero vectors; no infinite-n argument inferred from computation.
residual_risks: All-n proof uses parity-reduction transformation, not finite enumeration; n<3 and other characteristic-two fields excluded.

evidence: 2025 Theorems 3.9, 3.11 and 4.20 classify algebras and isometries, without equivalent explicit simultaneous H_{n,k} graph spectra.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The 2025 results are broader in fields/algebra classes but do not imply the current graph-spectra statement as an already demonstrated result without the parity/canonical orbit analysis.
